text: 65वें मिनट में Seabrook Town ने अपनी रणनीति बदलकर ज़ोर से प्रैस करना और सीधे खेलना शुरू किया, जिससे उन्होंने जल्द से जल्द विपक्षी के पास पहुंचने की कोशिश की[#1361]. इससे उनकी गेंद पर कंट्रोल थोड़ा बढ़ा, लेकिन गोल की संभावनाएं थोड़ा कम हो गईं, जिसका मतलब है कि उनके शॉट्स और मौके थोड़ा कम हुए[#1361]. Harbour City ने भी शांतिपूर्ण पासिंग कर के मैच में दबदबा बनाए रखा[#1361]. यह बदलाव धीमे और समझदार खेलने वाली मनोवृत्ति को तोड़ने की कोशिश थी, लेकिन Harbour City ने मजबूत बने रहने में कामयाबी पाई[#1361].

- Seabrook Town's line height increased from 0.6 to 0.72 following the new approach [#1361].  
- After the change, Seabrook Town's xG dropped slightly from 0.56 to 0.47, with shots reduced from 5 to 4 [#1361].

- Seabrook Town altered their tactics at the 65th minute to press higher up the pitch and play more direct, indicated by increases in pressing intensity (from 0.66 to 0.84), line height (from 0.6 to 0.72), and directness (from 0.42 to 0.57) [#1361]. This suggests an attempt to disrupt Harbour City's patient short passing style by closing down space quickly and launching more straightforward attacks.
- The shift reflects Seabrook Town's 3-4-3 formation, which benefits from wide players and crossing; increasing directness likely aimed to exploit wide areas more rapidly rather than building patiently, complementing their natural style.
- Despite higher pressing and directness, Seabrook Town's overall expected goals (xG) and shots slightly decreased post-change (xG fell from 0.56 to 0.47; shots from 5 to 4), possibly indicating Harbour City's ability to adapt to the increased pressure while maintaining possession (possession rose slightly from 53.6% to 54.4%) [#1361].
- The tactical change also saw a reduction in field tilt for Seabrook Town (from 70.7% to 45.7%), suggesting Harbour City managed to regain territorial control despite Seabrook’s intention to press higher and play more directly, showcasing Harbour City's resilience in their 4-2-3-1 formation and patient buildup approach.
